control.name: CONTROL — invert the open-state check (a closed PR becomes the only flippable one)

mutations.name: stop the changed-files walk after page one (the #208 defect, restated as a mutation)
stop asking the forge to paginate (one default-sized page becomes the whole diff)
trust a short read (the fail-closed reconcile against the forge's own total is disarmed)
disarm the path-trigger classification (a risky path stops risk-classing the PR)
let an unreadable changed-file list pass as an empty diff (could-not-check rounded to clean)
mutations.old:
return nil, deskkit.Unverifiable(fmt.Sprintf(
			"condition %s: cannot read PR #%d's changed files (%s) — a diff that could not be read is "+
				"could-not-check, and could-not-check is never a clean risk classification.",
			condSecurityVerdict, o.pr, firstLine(r.stderr)), r.err)

mutations.name: stop reducing to the latest run per name (a superseded CANCELLED/QUEUED run jams the flip again — reddens TestSupersededRunDoesNotJamACleanFlip)
keep the OLDER run per name instead of the latest, in the SHARED deskkit reducer (an obsolete SUCCESS masks a newer FAILURE — reddens deskflip's TestLatestRedRunStillRefuses through the shared path)
